rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: One provides authenticated access to 250+ platforms and 47,500+ actions through a single MCP integration. It handles OAuth and API key management automatically, so agents can search, document, and execute API calls across Gmail, Slack, Stripe, HubSpot, Salesforce, GitHub, and hundreds of other services without managing credentials directly. The platform includes scheduling, persistent memory, and channel deployment for Slack, WhatsApp, and Telegram.
